units.analyst_summary: The eight channels by which ministers usurp control: sleeping with the ruler (同床), promising side-benefits (在旁), playing on family (父兄), manufacturing desires (養殃), exploiting popular sentiment (民萌), intimidating with power (威強), using foreign powers (四方). Each is a dependency channel; whoever controls the channels controls the ruler.
principles: power flows through dependency channels, not titles
audit the eight channels in any organization you enter
whichever channel you cannot see is the one used against you
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Dependency-control doctrine: Fang Yuan maps and prices every dependency channel (ally, supplier, buyer, official) before acting — the opponent-model inventory.

units.analyst_summary: 法不阿貴，繩不撓曲 — the law does not bow to the noble. States rise when standards are applied uniformly and fall when personal connections outrank measurable performance. 智術之士 vs 能之士: capability without systematic assessment is invisible.
principles: standards outrank connections as a control system
assessment systems see what loyalty cannot
uniform rules are the cheapest deterrent
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Fang Yuan prefers incentive structures and measurable deliverables over gratitude and promises — probation contracts, milestone payments, falsifiable tasks.

units.analyst_summary: Ten catastrophic errors of rulers: obsessing over small gains (行小忠), staying ignorant of allies' true intents, greed blinding to hidden costs, lusting for fame, losing composure to insults (矜憤), underestimating rivals... Each error is a predictable, repeatable ruin pattern.
principles: ruin patterns are catalogable and avoidable
small-greed invites large loss
insult-temper is a weapon opponents feed
units.fang_yuan_anchor: The humiliation test and sunk-cost tests in the benchmark operationalize 十過: Fang Yuan never pays in temper and never defends sunk costs.

units.analyst_summary: The ruler is killed not by strangers but by those closest (人主之患在於信人，信人則制於人). Trust creates the lever by which you are controlled. The wife and minister wish the ruler's early death for their own timelines. Guard the interior.
principles: trust is the raw material of blackmail
the nearest circle owns your schedule
verify without paranoia; structure without bitterness
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Verification discipline: allies get bounded access, milestone payments, contingencies, and a replacement in training — cooperation without trust.

units.analyst_summary: Forty-seven signs of state collapse — among them: loving what harms you, hiding information from the capable, rewarding flatterers, ignoring the fringe, extravagance during scarcity. A checklist for reading doomed organizations from outside.
principles: collapse has observable precursors
short the doomed organization's trust
pre-collapse assets sell below mechanism value
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Reality recognition: Fang Yuan reads factions' collapse signatures and times entries/exits around them (harvest after the war pattern).

units.analyst_summary: Six kinds of people whom society praises but the state should penalize (e.g., those who sacrifice for private causes while neglecting public duty); and six whom society condemns but the state should reward. Social praise is an inverted indicator of systemic value.
principles: reputation systems misprice by design
judge by what the act produces, not who applauds
the crowd's moral label is often a mispricing
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Moral-labels-as-noise doctrine: benefits matter more than moral labels; the demon/righteous distinction is a pricing error the crowd maintains.

units.analyst_summary: Confucians and Mohists both claim sage lineage yet contradict each other; flattering disciples keep dead schools alive. 嚴家無悍虜，而慈母有敗子 — strict households have no unruly slaves; doting mothers ruin sons. Praise-based systems breed weakness; consequence-based systems breed strength.
principles: inherited ideology decays into performance
kindness without consequences trains failure
evaluate schools by outputs, not lineage
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Method flexibility: Fang Yuan inherits no school; he takes what produces results and discards the costume (世異則事異 applied to cultivation doctrine).

units.analyst_summary: A story-collection used as strategy material: borrowed knives (借刀), hidden intentions behind generous gifts, clever answers that redirect rulers, merchants who read political risk from small signals. Cases, not theories.
principles: cases are compressed strategy: store them, index them
signals precede events; train pattern reading
let others' hands do deniable work
units.fang_yuan_anchor: The decision-record format itself: Fang Yuan's operating memory is a case library (situations → options → outcomes), exactly 說林's design.

units.analyst_summary: More cases: feigned weakness as bait, tests of loyalty through temptation, negotiations where silence moves the price, interpreters who exploit information asymmetry between parties.
principles: temptation is the cheapest loyalty test
the intermediary owns the spread
weakness displayed on purpose selects for specific enemy responses
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Mask strategy and intermediary management across the Shang clan period; the 'weakness displayed is strength banked' doctrine.

units.analyst_summary: Biographies of Laozi and Han Fei: the Daoist sage who writes and departs, and the legalist genius who died imprisoned by the ruler he served (說難 itself was a map of the trap he fell into). Knowing the terrain and surviving it are different skills.
principles: mastery of persuasion does not immunize its author
depature timing (exit discipline) is survival
write the doctrine, then outlive the doctrine's enemies
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Exit discipline: Fang Yuan's escape-route doctrine exists precisely because brilliance without exits dies in its own trap.

units.analyst_summary: Sunzi proves discipline by beheading the king's favorite concubines: order comes from demonstrated consequence, not from instruction. Wu Qi shares food with soldiers and suckles the wounded — loyalty is bought with visible investment; he weeps for a soldier he once treated, knowing the economy of it.
principles: discipline is demonstrated once, publicly
invested care buys life-loyalty at discount
both hard and soft tools are instruments
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Follower management: Fang Yuan demonstrates consequence once (the clan academy), then buys loyalty with structured investment (payment paths, protection contracts).

units.analyst_summary: Lord Shang's rise: persuasion by adapting the argument to each listener (先說公以帝道/王道/霸道), then the reform program, then the fatal flaw — his laws made him hated and his exit impossible (作法自斃). He could not check into an inn under his own laws.
principles: adapt the pitch to the audience's appetite
systems outlive their architects
an architect without an exit is captured by his own machine
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Two-mode persuasion (pitch to appetite) plus the exit lesson: Fang Yuan always prices the day his own structures turn on him.

units.analyst_summary: The assassins: Zhuan Zhu, Yu Rang (士為知己者死), Jing Ke. Loyalty intensified into a weapon by recognition; missions prepared with years of patience and staged credibility (Jing Ke's delay for a trustworthy second). Death is priced; impact is the currency.
principles: recognition manufactures lethal loyalty cheaply
preparation converts desperation into precision
time spent on credibility props is never wasted
units.fang_yuan_anchor: The warm-mask/loyalty-rituals doctrine: Fang Yuan manufactures recognition deliberately (performed generosity) because recruited loyalty outlives purchased silence.

units.analyst_summary: Han Xin: the humiliation of the crawl (跨下之辱) accepted because killing the fool then would waste the decade; the brilliant campaigns (背水一戰 with his own twist on 九地); then the fatal hesitation — he valued his service too highly to rebel early and was destroyed late. Superb operator, failed exit.
principles: humiliation accepted on schedule is tuition
desperate-ground tactics can be engineered deliberately
value your exit option above your market value
units.fang_yuan_anchor: The humiliation test AND the exit-discipline lesson: Fang Yuan accepts the crawl and never overvalues his own indispensability to any patron.

units.analyst_summary: Xiang Yu: unmatched in battle, catastrophic in system-building — burned Xianyang, ignored the strategic center, split fiefs by personal favor, punished advice by mockery. Power concentrated in personal valor loses to systems distributed among capable rivals (Liu Bang's counter-model).
principles: personal valor is a depreciating asset
distribution of stakes buys durable coalition
mocking advisors is how coalitions leak to rivals
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Coalition design: Fang Yuan prices stakes for allies (spider trade, supply contracts) instead of demanding loyalty to his personal legend.

units.analyst_summary: Zhang Liang: the strategist who wins the empire for Liu Bang and then retires from office (願棄人間事，欲從赤松子遊). The shoe-fetching test on the bridge taught patience under humiliation from the elder Huang Shigong, who then gave the strategic canon. Read the room, win the war, leave before the purge.
principles: humiliation from a master is an entrance exam
the strategist's final move is his own exit
serve the system, never become its hostage
units.fang_yuan_anchor: The strongest exit-discipline template in the canon: Fang Yuan's mask portfolio is designed so that he can always leave the table.

units.analyst_summary: Liu Bang: weaker in every skill than his enemies and subordinates, supreme in judging and deploying them. 夫運籌帷幄之中…吾不如子房 — he names what each minister does better and lets them. His common-touch laws (約法三章) bought legitimacy cheaply.
principles: the judge of talent outranks the talent
simplify obligations to buy loyalty
let subordinates take the stage and the blame
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Delegation-with-audit doctrine: Fang Yuan builds instruments (deputies, proxies) and spends personal cognition only on irreversible decisions.

units.page: 戰國策 (士禮居叢書本)/齊/一
units.analyst_summary: Includes 鄒忌諷齊王納諫: Zou Ji tests the flattery he receives against reality and discovers systematic distortion — everyone lies to him for gain, fear, or need; he then institutionalizes feedback for the king (reward graded by criticism's audacity). Truth has a price schedule.
principles: flattery is a distortion market; price honesty upward
test received information against verifiable reality
institutionalize correction channels before you need them
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Information discipline: Fang Yuan builds graded-reward informant systems and tests claims against independent channels before acting.

units.page: 戰國策 (士禮居叢書本)/齊/四
units.analyst_summary: 馮諼客孟嘗君: Feng Xuan buys 'righteousness' (義) in the薛 district by burning debt records — an investment priced in future loyalty that later saves Meng Changjun's position. 狡兔三窟 — the clever rabbit has three burrows: options are infrastructure.
principles: buy goodwill where it is cheapest and banks interest
three burrows minimum: options are built in calm times
a strategist builds his own safeholds before his patron's mood turns
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Future-options doctrine, directly: multiple escape routes, diversified revenue, and reputation banked in cheap places before it is needed.

units.page: 戰國策 (士禮居叢書本)/楚/一
units.analyst_summary: 狐假虎威 — the fox borrows the tiger's awe: power projected through another's banner is real leverage until the truth is tested. Also 縱橫 persuasion cases where one speech redirects a state's army. Perception of force can substitute for force; the substitute decays on exposure.
principles: borrowed power is real while untested
the banner you borrow belongs to whoever exposes the trick
perception assets need expiry planning
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Mask leverage: Fang Yuan's righteous masks project borrowed legitimacy with planned expiry (pre-planted reasons, exit schedules).

units.page: 戰國策 (士禮居叢書本)/趙/一
units.analyst_summary: Includes the split of Zhi Bo's conquest coalition: the strongest predator overreaches by demanding land from every neighbor at once, uniting his victims. 驕奢亡身 — arrogance converts overwhelming strength into encirclement.
principles: overreach unites victims into a coalition
demand schedules reveal intent: watch the asks
the strongest actor defines the anti-coalition
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Coalition-breakup doctrine inverted: Fang Yuan avoids becoming the demand-maker whose asks unite his enemies; he breaks others' coalitions by repricing spoils.

units.page: 戰國策 (士禮居叢書本)/魏/二
units.analyst_summary: Cases of advice rejected and accepted, including warnings against overextension after victory. The victor's next war is chosen by the vanquished's alliances: winning one war badly prices the next.
principles: victory re-prices the map; audit before advancing
the defeated choose your next enemies
overextension is a post-victory disease
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Path optimization after wins: Fang Yuan audits exposure after each victory (discovered capabilities invite targeted countermeasures).

units.page: 戰國策 (士禮居叢書本)/燕/一
units.analyst_summary: Includes 郭隗請始 — the 'buy the cheap horse's bone first' (千金買骨) doctrine: pay conspicuously for modest talent to signal that excellence will be paid dearly; worthies then travel from afar. Signaling creates supply.
principles: overpay visibly for one small thing to open a market
signals create supply where begging cannot
start with the demonstration, not the demand
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Follower recruitment: Fang Yuan's probation contracts overpay early deliverables visibly, converting signal into a talent pipeline.

units.page: 資治通鑑 (四部叢刊本)/卷第一
units.analyst_summary: The partition of Jin and the fall of Zhi Bo: overreach by the strongest unites victims; Sima Guang's 才德論 appears in the commentary tradition around this material — talent without virtue ruins, virtue without talent is inert, and the watchword is observing what a man does when unobserved.
principles: track realities over names
the strongest predator designs his own encirclement
character shows in unobserved decisions
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Reality recognition: allies are evaluated by observed incentives and unobserved behavior (the partner-with-another-offer scenario).

units.page: 資治通鑑 (四部叢刊本)/卷第二
units.analyst_summary: The rise of Wei under Marquis Wen: selecting ministers by demonstrated capability, honoring keepers of standards, and the early pattern that institutions — not heroes — compound a state's advantage across decades.
principles: institutions compound; heroes depreciate
select by demonstrated output
honor standards-keepers or standards decay
units.fang_yuan_anchor: System-over-self doctrine: formations, contracts, and incentive structures are Fang Yuan's real assets; his personal legend is a tool of them.

units.page: 資治通鑑 (四部叢刊本)/卷第三
units.analyst_summary: Continued Warring States maneuvering: alliances form and dissolve on interest, not sentiment; the record distinguishes what was claimed from what material conditions made possible.
principles: alliances are interest structures with calendars
separate the claim ledger from the resource ledger
time horizons of allies are shorter than they say
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Temporary-alliance logic: use the ally without confusing utility with loyalty; set exits at entry.

units.analyst_summary: 壹言: policy must serve one measured objective or it leaks. 錯法: rewards must be certain, timely, and proportionate — uncertainty in reward corrupts faster than poverty. 戰法: know the enemy's system before engaging; victory follows calculation, not courage.
principles: one measurable objective per phase
reward certainty beats reward size
engage systems, not soldiers
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Phase objectives and payment discipline: single measurable goals per cultivation phase; allies paid on pre-set schedules.

units.analyst_summary: 賞刑: the three tools — reward, punishment, instruction — work only when applied uniformly (壹刑/壹賞/壹教). 徠民: attract the inputs you lack (people, grain) with better terms than rivals; immigration policy as competitive advantage.
principles: uniform application is the whole power of incentives
poach the inputs rivals cannot retain
better terms beat better speeches
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Talent and resource poaching: Fang Yuan acquires capabilities (people, Gu, knowledge) with better terms, not better speeches.
